dlg.action.music-ask.source: Another song, or a little quiet?
dlg.action.music-ask.target: 再来一曲，还是安静一会儿？

dlg.bard.another-verse.source: Another verse, or shall I rest my fingers by the fire?
dlg.bard.another-verse.target: 再来一段，还是让我在火边歇歇手指？

dlg.bard.another-verse-yes.source: Then another verse it is! This part is my favourite — the river joins in.
dlg.bard.another-verse-yes.target: 那就再来一段！这部分我最喜欢——河水也会跟着唱。

dlg.bard.from-the-top.source: Quiet suits a fire, but a song suits it better. Here — from the top.
dlg.bard.from-the-top.target: 安静和炉火很配，但歌声更配。来——从头开始。

dlg.bard.listener.source: A listener! Sit, sit. The fire is warm and my lute is — mostly — in tune.
dlg.bard.listener.target: 有听众！坐，快坐。炉火正暖，我的鲁特琴也——基本上——调准了。

dlg.bard.no-offence.source: No offence taken. Even a bard's fingers need a rest by the fire.
dlg.bard.no-offence.target: 没事，我不介意。吟游诗人的手指也得在火边歇一歇。

dlg.bard.song-intro.source: This one is called {Emberfall Evening}. I wrote it on that very bench, the night the falls turned gold.
dlg.bard.song-intro.target: 这首曲子叫《{烬落之暮}》。是我在那张长椅上写的，就在瀑布变成金色的那个夜晚。

dlg.bard.song-intro-playing.source: You have been hearing me since the square, I expect. This one is called {Emberfall Evening}. I wrote it on that very bench, the night the falls turned gold.
dlg.bard.song-intro-playing.target: 我猜你从广场那边就听见我在弹了。这首曲子叫《{烬落之暮}》。是我在那张长椅上写的，就在瀑布变成金色的那个夜晚。

dlg.child.duchess.source: Shh! I'm sneaking up on {Duchess}. She's the plump one. She's also the fastest, which is not fair at all.
dlg.child.duchess.target: 嘘！我正在悄悄靠近{公爵夫人}。就是那只胖乎乎的。它也是跑得最快的，一点都不公平。

dlg.child.eggs.source: Grandpa says if I catch her, I get to name the next batch of eggs!
dlg.child.eggs.target: 爷爷说，要是我抓住它，下一窝蛋就由我来起名字！

dlg.child.fence.source: ...Hey, you're tall. Could you be a fence? You just have to stand really, really still.
dlg.child.fence.target: ……喂，你好高呀。能当一下篱笆吗？只要站着一动、一动都不动就行。

dlg.drillmaster.boss-felled.source: You felled {Cinderheart}. I watched the glow go out of the caldera from the palisade — the whole camp cheered loud enough to wake the dummies.
dlg.drillmaster.boss-felled.target: 你击倒了{烬心}。我在栅栏上看着火山口的光熄灭——整个营地欢呼声震天，连假人都快被吵醒了。

dlg.drillmaster.first-watch.source: The pass has not been this quiet since my grandmother held this post. Rest by the fire tonight, soldier. You have earned the first watch off.
dlg.drillmaster.first-watch.target: 自从我祖母驻守这里以来，隘口还从没这么安静过。今晚就在火边好好休息吧，士兵。头一班岗你不用站了，这是你应得的。

dlg.drillmaster.glade-warning.source: The glade beyond the gate is crawling with slimes. Mind the goblins — they circle before they strike.
dlg.drillmaster.glade-warning.target: 大门外的林地里到处都是史莱姆。小心哥布林——它们会先绕着你转，再动手。

dlg.drillmaster.hold-there.source: Hold there, traveler. Nobody leaves this camp with a sword they cannot swing. I am {Captain Maren}, and the dummies are my recruits.
dlg.drillmaster.hold-there.target: 站住，旅人。挥不动剑的人，谁也别想离开这座营地。我是{玛伦队长}，这些假人是我的新兵。

dlg.drillmaster.remember.source: Remember: strike, roll, strike again. And rest at a {waystone} before you take on anything with a crown of fire.
dlg.drillmaster.remember.target: 记住：砍、滚、再砍。还有，在对付任何头顶火焰之冠的家伙之前，先在{路标石}旁休息。

dlg.drillmaster.reward.keys.source: Take these {Healing Draughts}. Drink one with {C} when the world starts to spin. Bram sells more at the stall.
dlg.drillmaster.reward.keys.target: 拿着这些{治疗药水}。天旋地转的时候，按{C}喝一瓶。布拉姆的摊子上还有得卖。

dlg.drillmaster.reward.pad.source: Take these {Healing Draughts}. Drink one with {Y} when the world starts to spin. Bram sells more at the stall.
dlg.drillmaster.reward.pad.target: 拿着这些{治疗药水}。天旋地转的时候，按{Y}喝一瓶。布拉姆的摊子上还有得卖。

dlg.drillmaster.roll.keys.source: Roll with {K (or the right mouse button)} while you move: for a heartbeat nothing can touch you. Roll just as a blow lands and the world slows for you.
dlg.drillmaster.roll.keys.target: 移动时按{K／鼠标右键}翻滚：一瞬之间，没有任何东西碰得到你。在攻击落下的刹那翻滚，世界就会为你放慢。

dlg.drillmaster.roll.pad.source: Roll with {B} while you move: for a heartbeat nothing can touch you. Roll just as a blow lands and the world slows for you.
dlg.drillmaster.roll.pad.target: 移动时按{B}翻滚：一瞬之间，没有任何东西碰得到你。在攻击落下的刹那翻滚，世界就会为你放慢。

dlg.drillmaster.satchel-full.source: I had draughts for you, but your satchel is full. Bram sells more at the stall when you need them.
dlg.drillmaster.satchel-full.target: 本来有药水给你，可你的挎包满了。需要的时候，布拉姆的摊子上有卖。

dlg.drillmaster.show-me.source: Show me a full three-cut combo on a dummy, and one good roll. Then come back to me.
dlg.drillmaster.show-me.target: 对假人打出一套完整的三连击，再来一次漂亮的翻滚给我看。然后回来找我。

dlg.drillmaster.skills.keys.source: Your skills are on {U, I and O (or 1–3)}, your draughts on {C}, and {L} fixes your eyes on one foe.
dlg.drillmaster.skills.keys.target: 技能在{U、I、O／1–3}，药水在{C}，按{L}能把目光锁定在一个敌人身上。

dlg.drillmaster.skills.pad.source: Your skills are on {LT with X, Y or B}, your draughts on {Y}, and {a click of the right stick} fixes your eyes on one foe.
dlg.drillmaster.skills.pad.target: 技能在{LT+X/Y/B}，药水在{Y}，{按下右摇杆}能把目光锁定在一个敌人身上。

dlg.drillmaster.strike.keys.source: Strike with {J (or the left mouse button)} — press it again as the blade comes back and you chain three cuts, the last one a thrust that knocks foes flat.
dlg.drillmaster.strike.keys.target: 按{J／鼠标左键}挥砍——剑刃收回时再按一次，就能连出三击，最后一记突刺能把敌人掀翻在地。

dlg.drillmaster.strike.pad.source: Strike with {X} — press it again as the blade comes back and you chain three cuts, the last one a thrust that knocks foes flat.
dlg.drillmaster.strike.pad.target: 按{X}挥砍——剑刃收回时再按一次，就能连出三击，最后一记突刺能把敌人掀翻在地。

dlg.drillmaster.wait-both.keys.source: Still waiting on a full three-cut combo on a dummy ({J (or the left mouse button)} three times) and one roll ({K (or the right mouse button)}). The dummies are patient. I am less so.
dlg.drillmaster.wait-both.keys.target: 我还在等你对假人打出一套完整的三连击（按{J／鼠标左键}三次），再来一次翻滚（{K／鼠标右键}）。假人有的是耐心，我可没那么多。

dlg.drillmaster.wait-both.pad.source: Still waiting on a full three-cut combo on a dummy ({X} three times) and one roll ({B}). The dummies are patient. I am less so.
dlg.drillmaster.wait-both.pad.target: 我还在等你对假人打出一套完整的三连击（按{X}三次），再来一次翻滚（{B}）。假人有的是耐心，我可没那么多。

dlg.drillmaster.wait-combo.keys.source: Still waiting on a full three-cut combo on a dummy ({J (or the left mouse button)} three times). The dummies are patient. I am less so.
dlg.drillmaster.wait-combo.keys.target: 我还在等你对假人打出一套完整的三连击（按{J／鼠标左键}三次）。假人有的是耐心，我可没那么多。

dlg.drillmaster.wait-combo.pad.source: Still waiting on a full three-cut combo on a dummy ({X} three times). The dummies are patient. I am less so.
dlg.drillmaster.wait-combo.pad.target: 我还在等你对假人打出一套完整的三连击（按{X}三次）。假人有的是耐心，我可没那么多。

dlg.drillmaster.wait-roll.keys.source: Still waiting on one roll ({K (or the right mouse button)}). The dummies are patient. I am less so.
dlg.drillmaster.wait-roll.keys.target: 我还在等你来一次翻滚（{K／鼠标右键}）。假人有的是耐心，我可没那么多。

dlg.drillmaster.wait-roll.pad.source: Still waiting on one roll ({B}). The dummies are patient. I am less so.
dlg.drillmaster.wait-roll.pad.target: 我还在等你来一次翻滚（{B}）。假人有的是耐心，我可没那么多。

dlg.drillmaster.well-done.source: Now that is a sword arm! A full combo and a clean roll — the dummies will be telling stories about you.
dlg.drillmaster.well-done.target: 这才叫好身手！一整套连击，外加一次干净利落的翻滚——假人们会把你的事迹传开的。

dlg.elder.founders.source: Our founders followed this river up from the lowlands four hundred years ago. At dusk the falls catch the last of the sun and glow like embers in a hearth.
dlg.elder.founders.target: 四百年前，我们的先祖从低地沿着这条河一路上溯而来。黄昏时分，瀑布接住最后一缕阳光，像炉膛里的余烬一样发亮。

dlg.elder.hence-the-name.source: Hence the name. We are not an imaginative people, but we are an honest one.
dlg.elder.hence-the-name.target: 村名就是这么来的。我们这儿的人没什么想象力，但为人老实。

dlg.elder.inn-tip.source: If your feet are weary, the {Ember & Oak} has a bed and a bowl of stew. Rosalind keeps the hearth warm and the gossip warmer.
dlg.elder.inn-tip.target: 要是走累了，{烬火橡木旅店}有床铺，也有一碗炖菜。罗莎琳德把炉火烧得暖暖的，闲话聊得更热乎。

dlg.elder.stair.source: Climb the stair by the inn some evening. The whole valley turns to gold up there.
dlg.elder.stair.target: 哪天傍晚，去爬爬旅店旁边的台阶吧。在上面看，整座山谷都会变成金色。

dlg.elder.still-here.source: Still here? Good. A village is only as warm as the company that lingers in it.
dlg.elder.still-here.target: 还在呀？好。一个村子暖不暖，全看留在这里的人。

dlg.elder.welcome.source: Ah, a traveler. Welcome to {Emberfall}, child. Mind the cobbles — they are older than I am, and twice as stubborn.
dlg.elder.welcome.target: 啊，是位旅人。欢迎来到{烬落村}，孩子。当心脚下的石子路——它们比我还老，脾气也比我倔一倍。

dlg.elder.well.source: Thirsty? The well is free to all. Its water comes down from {Windmill Hill}, and in all my years it has never once run dry.
dlg.elder.well.target: 渴了吗？那口井谁都可以用。井水是从{风车丘}流下来的，我活了这么多年，它一次都没干过。

dlg.farmer.chickens.source: If you see my granddaughter, tell her the chickens have filed a formal complaint.
dlg.farmer.chickens.target: 要是碰见我孙女，告诉她，鸡群已经正式提出投诉了。

dlg.farmer.soil.source: Soil's been kind this year. Rain came when we asked for it and kept away when we didn't. Can't ask fairer than that.
dlg.farmer.soil.target: 今年的土地很厚道。想要雨的时候就下，不想要的时候就不来。再公道不过了。

dlg.farmer.turnips.source: Hm? Oh, don't mind me. Just asking the turnips how they are getting on.
dlg.farmer.turnips.target: 嗯？哦，别管我。我就是问问这些萝卜长得怎么样了。

dlg.guard.all-quiet.source: All quiet on the bridge. Just the way I like it. ...Mostly.
dlg.guard.all-quiet.target: 桥上一切太平。我就喜欢这样。……大体上吧。

dlg.guard.ducks-and-gossip.source: Nothing has crossed this bridge in years but ducks and gossip, and I have yet to arrest either.
dlg.guard.ducks-and-gossip.target: 这些年来，过这座桥的只有鸭子和闲话，两样我都还没逮着过。

dlg.guard.grove.source: The grove beyond turns to amber this time of year. Keep to the path after dark — the river is gentle, but she is deeper than she looks.
dlg.guard.grove.target: 桥那头的林子每到这个时节就会变成琥珀色。天黑后别离开小路——这条河看着温顺，可比看上去深得多。

dlg.guard.halt.source: Halt! State your— ah. Forgive me, traveler. Force of habit.
dlg.guard.halt.target: 站住！报上你的——啊。抱歉，旅人。职业习惯。

dlg.innkeeper.good-morning.source: Good morning, sleepyhead! Breakfast is on the table, and the rooster has been shouting about it for an hour.
dlg.innkeeper.good-morning.target: 早上好，小懒虫！早饭已经摆上桌了，公鸡为这事都嚷嚷一个钟头了。

dlg.innkeeper.take-your-time.source: Take your time, dear. The fire will keep.
dlg.innkeeper.take-your-time.target: 慢慢来，不着急。炉火会一直烧着的。

dlg.innkeeper.welcome.source: Welcome to the {Ember & Oak}! Warm beds, hot stew, and only a modest amount of snoring from the loft.
dlg.innkeeper.welcome.target: 欢迎光临{烬火橡木旅店}！床铺暖和，炖菜滚烫，阁楼传来的呼噜声也只有一点点。

dlg.merchant.fine-choice.source: A fine choice! Crisp as a winter morning and twice as sweet. Come back tomorrow — I will have pears. Probably.
dlg.merchant.fine-choice.target: 好眼光！脆得像冬天的早晨，还甜上一倍。明天再来吧——我会进些梨。大概吧。

dlg.merchant.offer-apple.source: An apple, fresh from the valley orchards? For a new face in {Emberfall}, it is on the house.
dlg.merchant.offer-apple.target: 来个刚从山谷果园摘下的苹果吗？{烬落村}的新面孔，这个算我请客。

dlg.merchant.step-up.source: Step right up! The finest produce this side of the river — and the only produce this side of the river, but let us not dwell on that.
dlg.merchant.step-up.target: 快来看看！河这边最好的农产品——也是河这边唯一的农产品，不过这点咱们就别细究了。

dlg.scholar.golden-hour.source: Golden hour is my favourite. The shadows grow long and everything looks like it remembers something.
dlg.scholar.golden-hour.target: 我最喜欢夕照时分。影子拉得长长的，万物都像在回忆着什么。

dlg.scholar.notes-keys.source: And should you wish to see my working notes, {~} opens them. {H} will remind you of all this, should you forget.
dlg.scholar.notes-keys.target: 要是想看我的工作笔记，按{~}就能打开。万一忘了这些，{H}会提醒您。

dlg.scholar.remember.source: Remember: {T} for the hour, {R} for the weather, {P} for the view, {H} for help. The rest is patience.
dlg.scholar.remember.target: 记住：{T}换时辰，{R}换天气，{P}看风景，{H}看帮助。剩下的就靠耐心了。

dlg.scholar.time-key.source: Press {T} and watch the day turn — dawn, noon, golden hour, dusk and night. I have documented each one. Twice.
dlg.scholar.time-key.target: 按{T}，看一天如何流转——黎明、正午、夕照、黄昏，然后是夜晚。每一个我都记录过。记了两遍。

dlg.scholar.view-keys.source: {P} hides everything but the view. {Q} and {E} turn the world around you, and {Z} and {X} — or the wheel — bring it closer or push it away.
dlg.scholar.view-keys.target: {P}会隐去眼前景色以外的一切。{Q}和{E}让世界绕着您旋转，{Z}和{X}——或者滚轮——能把它拉近或推远。

dlg.scholar.visitor.source: Oh! A visitor on the hill. I am cataloguing how the light moves over this valley. Would you believe it is different every hour?
dlg.scholar.visitor.target: 哦！山丘上来了位访客。我正在记录光线如何在这座山谷上移动。您信吗？每个小时都不一样。

dlg.scholar.weather-key.source: {R} summons the weather: rain, then snow, then clear skies again. Do not ask me how. Scholarship has its limits.
dlg.scholar.weather-key.target: {R}能召来天气：先是雨，然后是雪，再变回晴天。别问我原理。学问也有尽头。

dlg.shopkeeper.farewell-bought.source: A pleasure doing business. Mind the fire up there.
dlg.shopkeeper.farewell-bought.target: 做您生意真愉快。山上那把火，您可当心点。

dlg.shopkeeper.farewell-none.source: Suit yourself. The cart is not going anywhere.
dlg.shopkeeper.farewell-none.target: 随您便。我这车又跑不了。

dlg.shopkeeper.foes-near.source: Not with foes at your heels! Lose them first, then we can talk trade.
dlg.shopkeeper.foes-near.target: 后面还跟着敌人呢！先甩掉它们，咱们再谈买卖。

dlg.shopkeeper.menu-again.source: Anything else? You carry {${gold} gold} · ATK ${atk} · DEF ${def}.
dlg.shopkeeper.menu-again.target: 还要别的吗？你身上有{${gold} 金币} · 攻击 ${atk} · 防御 ${def}。

dlg.shopkeeper.menu-first.source: What will it be? You carry {${gold} gold} · ATK ${atk} · DEF ${def}.
dlg.shopkeeper.menu-first.target: 要点什么？你身上有{${gold} 金币} · 攻击 ${atk} · 防御 ${def}。
